method_basis: paper/sec/3_method.tex:93-103 describes CCM reading local component features into shared memory and writing context back.

semantics: Background, vehicle and human each exchange information bidirectionally with one shared context pool. The completed rear cap and background road patch retain their gold marks. This depicts the joint-completion mechanism together with its composed scene output.
visual_review: One integrated wide scene with no text, titles, component names, legend, border, watermark or duplicate actor.
A single context strip contains interleaved teal, blue and purple tiles rather than three independent pools.
Three separate branches visibly have arrowheads at both ends: teal background to the pool, blue vehicle to the pool, purple human to the same pool.
Each branch terminates at its intended component anchor; no link is presented as a camera or object motion path.
Gold rear and road regions remain; no new human hole or gold human patch is invented.
The P2-view scene arrangement and pastel style remain visually consistent, with space added below for the context strip.
review_scope: Conceptual illustration and schematic information links, not measured feature flow, calibrated geometry or experimental output. Tile count is illustrative.
